producer|{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-final-season-interview|text=The Minds Behind ''Star Wars Resistance'' on What's Ahead in the Final Season}}}} '''''Star Wars Resistance''''' is an animated television series that premiered on [[October 7]], [[2018]], and concluded on [[January 26]], [[2020]], having aired on [[Disney Channel]] and [[Disney XD]]. The series was created by [[Dave Filoni]] and executive produced by [[Athena Yvette Portillo]], [[Justin Ridge]], and [[Brandon Auman]]. It stars [[Christopher Sean]], [[Josh Brener]], [[Suzie McGrath]], [[Scott Lawrence]], and [[Justin Ridge]], with special appearances from [[Oscar Isaac]] as [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Gwendoline Christie]] as [[Captain]] [[Phasma]]. ==Plot summary== {{Quote|We wanted to give a slice of life in a part of the galaxy that wasn't about the Jedi. How do people who are maybe not as connected with the Force, or at least they don't think they are, how did they respond to these threats? What do we do in the meantime when there isn't really a war going on?|Justin Ridge|{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/how-star-wars-resistance-is-using-its-new-time-period-t-1829502907|text=How ''Star Wars Resistance'' Is Using Its New Time Period to Its Advantage|author=Luisser, Germain|date=2018-10-05|work=[[Wikipedia:Gizmodo|Gizmodo]]|archivedate=20191029020834}}}} The series is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], in a time when the [[Resistance]] is still learning about the [[Cold War|growing threat]] of the [[First Order]]. It centers on the character of [[Kazuda Xiono]], a young [[pilot]] in [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] [[Resistance]] who is tasked with spying on the growing threat of the First Order. [[Wikipedia:Slashfilm|Slashfilm]] reported November 12, 2018 that a more specific timeline was revealed in episode 1.6 of [[Resistance Rewind]]. In that episode, executive producer Justin Ridge let slip that ''Star Wars Resistance'' takes place six months before the events of ''The Force Awakens'', revealing: "Because this series takes place six months before The Force Awakens we have a lot of connective tissue to what we see in the movie. So eventually our events in the show will parallel what happens in the movie."{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.6: Whispers of the First Order|video=ez0hN6svdX8|sw_url=video/whispers-of-the-first-order-resistance-rewind}} ==Development== {{Quote|So right now, Resistance is a bit different, in that I'm not on that day-to-day. I created and set it in motion, but I've given that to other people to raise up, people that I've worked with a long time, who I think deserve the opportunity to tell stories and I think it's exciting, and I give them my thoughts and notes – I was just doing that this morning, like George would give me. So that's fun.|Dave Filoni on his involvement with the series|{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2018/08/12/star-wars-rebels-season-4-finale-clone-wars-final-season-revival-disney-dave-filoni|text=Star Wars Rebels Creator Dave Filoni Reveals How Season 4 Almost Ended and His Clone Wars Revival Plans|author=Huver, Scott|date=2018-08-12|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20200524074632}}}} [[File:Star_Wars_Resistance_Title_Card.png|thumb|right|250px|A promotional banner released with the announcement of ''Star Wars Resistance'' on StarWars.com]] ''Star Wars Resistance'' was created by [[Dave Filoni]], head of [[Lucasfilm Animation]] who led the creative team on ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The inspiration for the series was Filoni's interest in [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]] aircraft and fighter pilots, with his grandfather's time as a pilot during the war being a particular influence on him. In the announcement of the series, Filoni noted that the series would capture the sense of excitement around high-speed racing, which ''Star Wars'' had depicted in many stories over the years. Executive producer [[Justin Ridge]] elaborated: "It was a concept Dave came up with: he wanted to have a show that went more into 'How is the First Order gathering materials? What is the First Order doing before ''The Force Awakens''?' It grew from that initial seed."{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2018/10/05/how-star-wars-resistance-is-intended-to-set-up-the-force-awakens|text=How Star Wars Resistance Is Intended to Set Up The Force Awakens|author=Huver, Scott|date=2018-10-05|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20200313195708}} For the show's setting, Filoni was also inspired by the sitcom [[Wikipedia:Cheers|''Cheers'']]; executive producer [[Athena Yvette Portillo]] explained this to [[StarWars.com]]: "He said, 'I want a show that takes place in one set that you go to constantly. You get to know the patrons, you get to know the people, and you introduce new characters…and it's all about their way of life.{{' "}} ''Resistance'' begins six months before the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], and eventually crosses over with the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].{{WebCite|url=https://www.syfy.com/syfywire/star-wars-resistance-harbors-crazy-deep-cuts-and-will-cross-over-with-the-force-awakens|text=Star Wars Resistance harbors crazy deep cuts and will cross over with The Force Awakens|author=Young, Bryan|date=2018-10-02|work=[[Wikipedia:Syfy|Syfy]]|archivedate=20191227161942}} When the series began development, the creative team was unsure of the details of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], so they had to be careful to avoid any possible continuity conflicts with those films.{{WebCite|url=https://www.polygon.com/2018/10/3/17929868/star-wars-resistance-cartoon-force-awakens-episode-9-story-gaps|text=How the Star Wars Resistance cartoon threads the needle of Disney's movie trilogy|author=Hall, Charlie|date=2018-10-03|work=[[Wikipedia:Polygon (website)|Polygon]]|archivedate=20200305073238}} The show was planned to last only two seasons, so as to bridge the gap between the two films.{{WebCite|url=https://comicbook.com/starwars/2019/09/30/star-wars-resistance-season-2-interview-justin-ridge-athena-portillo-brandon-auman|text=Star Wars Resistance Producers Discuss Connecting to the Bigger Galaxy and Upcoming Adventures|author=Cavanaugh, Patrick|date=2019-09-30|work=[https://comicbook.com ComicBook.com]|archivedate=20200729220759}}{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/why-star-wars-resistance-is-ending-before-the-rise/1100-6470187|text=Why Star Wars Resistance Is Ending Before The Rise Of Skywalker|archivedate=20191217234812}} [[File:Resistance-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art of a race around Colossus]] In [[September]] [[2016]], [[Wikipedia:Disney–ABC Television Group|Disney Television]] president [[Wikipedia:Ben Sherwood|Ben Sherwood]] revealed that he had been working with Lucasfilm on a new animated series.{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/ben-sherwood-interview-star-wars-tv-series-primetime-plans-more-928151|text=Disney/ABC TV's Ben Sherwood on a 'Star Wars' Series, "Mistakes" in Michael Strahan's 'Live' Exit and Bob Iger's Future|author=Guthrie, Marisa|date=2016-09-14|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20200515004151}} When the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of ''Star Wars Rebels'' debuted, it was announced that Filoni had stepped down as Supervising Director, in lieu of helping to develop "future animation development."{{WebCite|url=http://bigshinyrobot.com/59820/star-wars-rebels-filoni-no-longer-supervising-director|text='Star Wars Rebels:' Filoni No Longer Supervising Director|author=Young, name ''Star Wars Resistance''{{WebCite|url=http://yakfaceforums.com/main/2018/02/21/new-lucasfilm-filings-for-star-wars-resistance|text=New Lucasfilm Filings for "Star Wars Resistance"|date=2018-02-21|work=Yakface|archivedate=20180223031540}}{{WebCite|url=http://comicbook.com/starwars/2018/02/21/star-wars-animated-series-rebels-resistance|text=Does a Lucasfilm Trademark to [[2014]]).{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/new-star-wars-animated-series|text=Rumor: 'Star Wars Rebels' Follow-Up Animated Series to Be Set During Current Star Wars Cinematic Era|author=Lussier, Germain|date=2014-11-25|work=[[Wikipedia:/Film|Slashfilm]]|archivedate=20200105211630}} The series was officially announced on [[April 26]], 2018 for a debut in the fall of that year. Despite creating the show, Filoni confirmed in an [[August 12]] interview that he would not be working as directly in a day-to-day capacity on ''Resistance'' as he had on previous projects, given his work on the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|revival]] of ''The Clone Wars'', but he would still provide notes and direction to the story team, a role Filoni compared to [[George Lucas]]' input on ''The Clone Wars''. The show's animations were produced by [[Polygon Pictures]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.ppi.co.jp/works/star-wars-resistance|text=Star Wars: Resistance|work=[[Polygon Pictures]]|archivedate=20191026010129}} They are rendered in [[Wikipedia:Computer animation|CG]] and based on the [[Wikipedia:Anime|anime]] animation style,{{Twitter|Tcann13|status/1023284118862233600|[[Tracy Cannobbio]]|quote=Hi! #StarWarsResistance is a CG animated show, with an anime inspired design. Hope that helps! We'll be sharing more news very soon. Have a great weekend too! :)}} with major inspirations being [[Wikipedia:Robotech|''Robotech'']], [[Wikipedia:Lupin the Third|''Lupin the Third'']] and the films of [[Wikipedia:Hayao Miyazaki|Hayao Miyazaki]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.animationmagazine.net/tv/the-force-is-alive-and-animated-in-star-wars-resistance|text=The Force Is Alive (and Animated) in 'Star Wars Resistance'|author=Zahed, Ramin|date=2018-09-28|work=[[Wikipedia:Animation Magazine|Animation Magazine]]|archivedate=20190719033544}} Many of the show's designs are based on unused [[original trilogy]] concept sketches from artists such as [[Joe Johnston]], [[Ralph McQuarrie]], and [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]].{{SW|url=news/designing-star-wars-resistance|text=Designing ''Star Wars'': ''Star Wars Resistance''}} During production, the animated series was called "Zero."{{ArtStation|subdomain=jimmoore|url=projects/y8kN9|name=[[Jim Moore]]|text=LucasFIlm Animation|date=2018-06-28|quote=Preproduction and production art across several series from my time at Lucasfilm Animation}} ==Release and reception== ''Star Wars Resistance'' premiered on [[October 7]], 2018. In the days leading up to the premiere, the show had a presence at the 2018 [[Wikipedia:New York Comic Con|New York Comic Con]]; a life-sized model of the ''[[Fireball]]'' was present,{{SW|url=news/nycc-2018-the-fireball-lands-at-the-javits-center|text=NYCC 2018: The ''Fireball'' Lands at the Javits Center}} and [[Hasbro]] released a [[Star Wars Resistance (toy line)|toy line]] based on the series.{{SW|url=news/nycc-2018-hasbro-star-wars-resistance|text=NYCC 2018: Hasbro Joins the ''Resistance''}} On [[August 4]], 2019, it was announced that the second season would premiere on [[October 6]], 2019 when the Season 2 trailer was released. It was also revealed to be the final season of the show. In [[2019]], the first season was nominated for an [[Wikipedia:Emmy Award|Emmy]] for "Outstanding Children's Programming,"{{WebCite|url=https://www.emmys.com/awards/nominees-winners/2019/outstanding-childrens-program|text=71st Emmy Awards Nominees and Winners|work=[[Wikipedia:Emmy Awards|Emmy Awards]]|archivedate=20190717003216}} and won a [[Wikipedia:Saturn Award|Saturn]] for "Best Animated Television Series."{{WebCite|url=https://www.animationmagazine.net/events/saturn-awards-spider-verse-star-wars-resistance-win-animation-honors|text=Saturn Awards: 'Spider-Verse,' 'Star Wars Resistance' Win Animation Honors|author=Milligan, Mercedes|date=2019-09-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Animation Magazine|Animation Magazine]]|archivedate=20191211191207}} In [[2020]], the second season was also nominated for an Emmy for "Outstanding Children's Program."{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-emmys-2020|text=''The Mandalorian'' Nominated for 15 Emmys}} ===Home video=== The first season was released on [[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|DVD]] on [[August 20]], 2019.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-one-dvd|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One Coming to DVD on August 20}} Both seasons are available on the [[Disney+]] streaming service. The first season was available at launch on [[November 12]], 2019,{{WebCite|url=http://www.swnz.co.nz/2019/11/16/disney-in-nz-your-questions-answered|text=Disney+ in NZ – Your Questions Answered|author=G., Matt|date=2019-11-16|work=[https://swnz.co.nz SWNZ, Star Wars New Zealand]|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/GBOP6}} and the second season became available on [[February 25]], [[2020]].{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/new-on-disney-plus-february-2020|text=Here's What's New on Disney+ in February 2020|author=Lawrence, Gregory|date=2020-01-23|archivedate=20200125032840}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from Star Wars Resistance|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Resistance}} ===Seasons=== {|class="wikitable" ! Yes - the #StarWarsResistance season finale airs on March 17th.|archivedate=20200529234409}} |creators=[[Dave Filoni]] |writers= |directors= |executive producers=*[[Athena Yvette Portillo]] *[[Justin Ridge]] *[[Brandon Auman]] |production company= |starring= |timeline=[[34 ABY]]{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} establishes that the events of ''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One take place thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. |preceded by= |followed by=[[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two]] }} '''''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One''' is the first season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. It is comprised of twenty-one episodes and premiered on [[October 7]], [[2018]] on [[Disney Channel]], beginning with the two-part episode "[[The Recruit]]." In addition, twelve animated shorts were released in [[December]] during the mid-season break. A [[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|home video]] release of the season was released on [[August 20]], [[2019]]. ==Official description== ''Poe and BB-8 assign Kaz to the Colossus, where he meets a cast of colorful new aliens, droids and creatures. While undercover to spy on the growing threat of the First Order, Kaz works as a mechanic and lives with Poe's old friend Yeager — a veteran pilot who operates a starship repair shop run by his crew: Tam, Neeku and a battered old astromech called Bucket''. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from Star Wars Resistance Season One|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Resistance Season One}} ===Episodes=== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" !
